ui.library.time.minutes_m_ago.tone: Concise neutral desktop UI copy, sentence case, no exclamation marks.
ui.library.time.minutes_m_ago.note: English source: {minutes, plural, one {{minutes, number, ::group-off}m ago} other {{minutes, number, ::group-off}m ago}}. The English form is deliberately compact ("4m ago"): a single unit letter, no space before it, and it sits in a narrow sidebar and metadata slot. This string is a FRAGMENT composed into a larger sentence by its caller ("Last organized {at}", "Organized by {by} {at}"), so it must read as an adverbial phrase on its own and must not become a full sentence.
ui.library.time.minutes_m_ago.length: English is 104 source characters. Keep the same shape and a comparable width.

placeholders.minutes: Whole minutes, floored by the caller; never negative.

ui.library.time.minutes_m_ago.plural: ICU plural: keep one/other and the minutes variable; French adds many, Russian adds few/many. The compact unit abbreviation is the point — do not spell the unit out.
